phase3_note: Phase-3 (cutover / making shadow an authority) is explicitly OUT OF SCOPE and absent from this stage model. No stage promotes shadow to any authority.
invariants: shadow_enabled is explicit on every stage.
Only Stage F or later may have shadow_enabled true.
Deployment (Stage D) and activation (Stage F) are DISTINCT stages.
Every stage has a rollback plan.
consumer_live stays false in every stage (never a Phase-2 activation vector).
No stage introduces Redis or SQL.
N-1 (JSONL append atomicity) and N-2 (redaction coverage) hardening land BEFORE any shadow_enabled stage.
Current Mode-C reconnect authority remains fully authoritative in every stage.

Stage B is BLOCKED unless the clean exact-SHA build context (F-DR-01) is produced AND source-SHA + build-UTC OCI provenance labels (F-DR-02) are present and correct. Stage B FAILS if either control is absent or incorrect. These controls are MANDATORY for every future candidate image and are NOT optional recommendations.

The legacy image c5fc2a62f424 (no provenance labels) is NOT retroactively invalid; the F-DR-02 label requirement is scoped to future candidate images only and the legacy image does not set the contract for new candidate images.

stages.name: Cumulative readiness verify
stages.purpose: Verify the cumulative PR103-111 delta at base adc21c4d is deploy-safe: per-PR classification, no runtime importer of Phase-2, only PR103 auto-changes a runtime module, dependency-lock unchanged.
actions: Re-run nine-PR classification against canonical code

rollback.action: No system change; abort the deploy sequence. No runtime touched.

stages.name: Image build only
stages.purpose: Build a single reproducible image from pinned canonical SHA adc21c4d using a MANDATORY clean exact-SHA build context (F-DR-01) and MANDATORY source-SHA + build-UTC OCI labels (F-DR-02). No container replaced.
stages.blocking_controls_note: Stage B FAILS if the clean exact-SHA context cannot be produced (F-DR-01) or if the source-SHA + build-UTC labels are absent/incorrect (F-DR-02). Verified by tools/hermes_image_label_verify_v1.py; the revision label MUST equal the clean-context source SHA.
actions: docker build from that clean context at adc21c4d
Attach + verify MANDATORY source-SHA + build-UTC labels (F-DR-02)

rollback.action: Discard built image; nothing deployed. Prior image c5fc2a62f424 remains live.

stages.exit_audit: Image built, labelled, digest recorded, scans clean, Phase-2 present-but-inactive proven in image.
stages.gate: Build succeeds + scans clean + F-DR-01 clean-context reproducible + F-DR-02 provenance labels present and correct (Stage B FAILS otherwise).

stages.name: Deployment-readiness audit
stages.purpose: Audit the built image before any container replace: proof Phase-2 present-but-inactive, no active import, no config default activates, no JSONL path created at image start.
actions: Confirm N-1/N-2 hardening WOs merged (blocking gate for later shadow-enable)

rollback.action: Fail the audit; do not deploy. Prior image stays live.

stages.name: Deploy-dark (disabled config, shadow off)
stages.purpose: Replace the container with the new image carrying a DISABLED Phase-2 config (shadow_enabled=false). Validate health + market-data unchanged; reconnect authority unchanged. This is DEPLOYMENT, not activation.
preconditions: Disabled config validated (schema) and mounted, not embedded
actions: Governed container replace with new image
Validate /health, market-data flow, restart count, config v3
Confirm no JSONL created, no reconnect-authority change

rollback.action: Revert to prior image digest c5fc2a62f424 (source 71ea3bd) + prior config; verify health; record restart count.

stages.exit_audit: Deploy-dark healthy; Phase-2 inert in the running container.
stages.gate: Health + market-data validate; rollback window honoured.

stages.name: Post-deploy-dark audit
stages.purpose: Audit the running deploy-dark container: Phase-2 present-but-inactive, no JSONL, no reconnect change, authority intact. Confirm N-1 and N-2 hardening are closed BEFORE authorising any shadow-enable.
preconditions: Stage D healthy for the rollback window

rollback.action: If audit fails, shadow-disable is already the state; if a defect is found, rollback to c5fc2a62f424. No shadow-enable authorised.

stages.exit_audit: R2D2 post-deploy-dark audit GREEN; N-1/N-2 closed; deploy-dark is a stable steady state.
stages.gate: R2D2 audit + N-1/N-2 blocking gate closed.

stages.name: Separately-authorised shadow-enable (config-only)
stages.purpose: SEPARATE, independently-authorised activation: a config-only mutation sets shadow_enabled=true (consumer_live stays false). No image change. Explicit UTC start, bounded, with a disable path. Zero reconnect authority.

rollback.action: Config-only shadow-disable (shadow_enabled=false). No image change needed. Reconnect authority never depended on shadow.

stages.exit_audit: Shadow enabled, reconnect authority still fully authoritative, evidence writing bounded.

stages.name: Live shadow observation
stages.purpose: Bounded live observation: shadow evaluates read-only immutable snapshots, writes evidence JSONL, compares against current authority. Shadow proposals never affect reconnect.

rollback.action: Config-only shadow-disable if overhead/interference/anomaly; evidence preserved.

stages.exit_audit: Observation window complete; evidence bundle produced.
stages.gate: Bounded window elapsed or disable triggered.

stages.name: Post-observation R2D2 audit
stages.purpose: R2D2 audits shadow observation evidence. Terminal for THIS programme. NO Phase-3 cutover is in scope.
actions: Record findings for a FUTURE, separately-authorised programme

rollback.action: Shadow-disable is the resting state after observation; no cutover.

stages.exit_audit: R2D2 post-observation audit complete; programme ends without cutover.
stages.gate: Terminal. Any further step is a NEW governed programme (out of scope).
